slots.hero.title:
Built to your walls.
Not to a range.
slots.hero.body: Bespoke wardrobes, media walls and home offices — designed, made and fitted from our Skelmanthorpe workshop, to your millimetre.
slots.panel.wardrobes.title: Wardrobes that fit like they grew there.
slots.panel.wardrobes.body: Fitted, corner returns, walk-ins — hinged or mirrored, with the insides planned around what you actually own. Measured to the millimetre so there's no filler, no gap, no compromise.
slots.panel.media.title: Media walls without the wobble.
slots.panel.media.body: A floating base that takes real weight, shelving that lines through, and a cable spine behind the TV so the wall stays clean. Built as one piece of joinery, not a flat-pack tower.
slots.panel.finishes.title: The material is the product.
slots.panel.finishes.body: Three thousand Egger decors — real oak grains, painted colours, stone-look matts. We build the same way in all of them; the finish is where it becomes yours.
slots.range.title: One product. Three thousand ways.
slots.range.body: Every piece we make is one thing — an Egger decor, built into furniture for your room. Oak grains, walnut, painted matts and stone looks; the same honest 18mm board underneath, the finish is where it becomes yours.
slots.feature.wardrobes.title: Wardrobes that fit like they grew there.
slots.feature.wardrobes.body: Fitted, corner returns and walk-ins — hinged or mirrored, planned around what you actually own. Measured to the millimetre, so there's no filler and no gap.
slots.feature.media.title: Media walls, built as one piece.
slots.feature.media.body: A floating base that takes real weight, shelving that lines through, LED accents and a cable spine so the wall stays clean — not a flat-pack tower.
slots.statement.text: “Every millimetre of your room — priced from the cutting list, and fitted by the people who built it.”

slots.manifesto.title: Bespoke, honestly priced, fitted by us.
slots.manifesto.1.title: Truly bespoke, honestly priced.
slots.manifesto.1.body: Priced from the cutting list, not a price book — you see what every panel, hinge and drawer costs.
slots.manifesto.2.title: Made in our workshop.
slots.manifesto.2.body: Cut on our own CNC in Skelmanthorpe, edge-banded and assembled by the people who'll fit it.
slots.manifesto.3.title: Fitted by the makers.
slots.manifesto.3.body: No subcontract chain — the team that built your furniture installs it, usually in a day.
slots.enquiry.title: Tell us about your room.
slots.enquiry.body: We'll come and measure, talk through what you need, and price it honestly. Visits take about 45 minutes.
slots.enquiry.note: Your enquiry goes straight to the Sturij team. We'll be in touch within a working day.
slots.calculator.title: What might it cost? An honest band.
slots.calculator.body: Choose what we're making, its width and its specification. You'll see a from–to guide based on recent projects — never a single figure. The exact price comes from your measurements at the design visit, priced from the cutting list.
slots.access.heading: Everyone should be able to use this site.
slots.access.intro: We want sturij.com to work for everyone, whatever device or assistive technology you use. This statement says what we aim for, what we know falls short, and how to tell us.
slots.access.standard: We aim for the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. Every page is built to be read by a screen reader, worked with a keyboard alone, and shown without motion where your device asks for it; text keeps its contrast against the paper and the charcoal, and every image carries a description.
slots.access.known: Known exceptions: the finish galleries scroll as a marquee, which stops under reduced motion; the swatch viewer and the room visualiser are visual tools and describe their result in words beside the image; the Studio, which this site links to, is an older application and does not yet meet this standard.
slots.access.contact: If something here does not work for you, tell us and we will fix it or find you another way: contact@sturij.com or 01937 326011.
slots.access.reviewed: This statement was prepared in September 2026 and is reviewed with every change to the site.
